page.overview:
Who is Future Gohanks?

Future Gohanks wears the same clothes all Metamorans and other fusion characters were seen wearing, a dark blue and yellow vest. Around his waist is a teal sash, and he wears white silky pants, dark shoes with teal wraps, and black wristbands. His hair is a combination of Future Gohan's black hair covering most of his head, with two lilac bangs that comes from Future Trunks' hair. Future Gohanks retains Future Trunks' skin tone and sword, which unlike Xeno Gotenks, he is seen using it during a special technique in Dragon Ball Heroes. Future Gohanks also retains Future Gohan's scar on his left part of the face and his eyebrows remain lilac and black eyes.

While Future Gohanks did not present his full personality, as being the result of Future Gohan and Future Trunks fusing, both lived for many years in an apocalyptic future, Future Gohanks is more serious and does mean business compared to Gotenks and EX Gohanks, resembling Gogeta from Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn.

;Video Games In Dragon Ball Fusions, Future Gohanks is classified as a S-rank character. Additionally, his description suggests that he is strong enough to defeat Future Android 17 and Future Android 18, indicating had Future Trunks and Future Gohan been able to fuse in their timeline, then Future Gohanks could have rid their future timeline of the Android menace.

Future Gohanks is also stronger than his counterpart EX-Fusion counterpart EX Gohanks due to being a product of Metamoran Fusion and being comprised of the more experienced and more compatible Future Gohan and Future Trunks, as EX Gohanks' fusee Teen Gohan and Kid Trunks are younger and practically strangers due to being from different eras. Compared to his Time Patroller counterpart Xeno Gohanks, however, Future Gohanks is likely weaker, since Xeno Gohanks' fusees Xeno Gohan and Xeno Trunks, both much stronger and more experienced Time Patrollers with access to Super Saiyan 3.
